title: The Last Echo Anew
author: Jonah Quintana
blurb: Oscar Thornbury, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
